# MP4toMP3.online

> Free online MP4 to MP3 converter. Convert MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, AVI video files to MP3 audio in the browser. Files are processed entirely client-side using FFmpeg.wasm — they never leave the user's device. No sign-up, no watermark, no upload to server.

MP4toMP3.online is a browser-based audio extraction tool. It accepts any video file the user uploads (or a direct file URL, Google Drive share link, or Dropbox share link) and extracts the audio track as a high-quality MP3 file. Conversion happens entirely in the browser using FFmpeg compiled to WebAssembly — there is no server-side processing of media.

## Primary use cases

- Convert MP4 to MP3 for podcast editing
- Extract audio from a Zoom or Google Meet recording
- Pull audio from iPhone voice memos recorded as video
- Convert MOV (QuickTime) files from Mac/iPhone to MP3
- Convert MKV (Matroska) files to MP3
- Convert WAV/M4A audio files to MP4 video format (for uploading audio to YouTube/Instagram/TikTok)
- Convert MP4 to lossless WAV for professional audio editing

## Supported input formats

MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, AVI, M4V, FLV, 3GP (video); MP3, M4A, AAC, WAV, OGG, Opus, FLAC (audio).

## Supported output formats

- MP3 (default) — libmp3lame VBR ~190 kbps, universally compatible
- WAV — lossless PCM 16-bit 44.1 kHz stereo, for editing
- MP4 — H.264 video + AAC audio, for uploading audio to video platforms

## How it works

1. User uploads a file or pastes a URL
2. The browser downloads FFmpeg.wasm (~30 MB, cached after first load)
3. FFmpeg extracts the audio track and re-encodes it as MP3/WAV/MP4
4. The output file is delivered as a browser blob download
5. Temporary files are deleted from FFmpeg's virtual filesystem immediately

## Limitations

- Maximum file size: 500 MB
- Conversion speed depends on file length and user's device (single-threaded WASM is ~3x slower than native FFmpeg, but works on every browser without special headers)
- Cannot convert from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, Spotify, Netflix, SoundCloud, Vimeo, Twitch, or other streaming/social platforms — these serve HTML pages, not direct video files, and downloading from them violates copyright law
- Cannot process DRM-protected files (e.g., iTunes purchases, Netflix downloads)

## Privacy

- Files are processed entirely in the user's browser — they never leave the device
- No server-side storage of uploaded media
- No account, no tracking of file contents, no PII collected
- The only third-party scripts loaded are Google Tag Manager (for aggregate, anonymous analytics events like "conversion_started") and the FFmpeg WASM core from jsDelivr CDN

## Technology

- Built with Next.js 16 (App Router) and TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS 4 + shadcn/ui for the interface
- FFmpeg.wasm (@ffmpeg/ffmpeg v0.12.15) for client-side audio extraction
- Deployed on Vercel
- Analytics via Google Tag Manager (GTM-NW8NRWVZ) — GA4 managed through GTM, not installed directly
